questions.question_html:
The correct statements with respect to dialysis of colloidal solution are
I. Colloidal particles can pass through the membrane
II. Animal bladder can be used as membrane
III. Cellophane is not used as membrane
IV. Ions or small molecules can diffuse through membrane into water
questions.option_a: I, II only
questions.option_b: II, III only
questions.option_c: III. IV only
questions.option_d: II, IV only
questions.solution_html:
I. Size of colloidal particles are larger than the size of pores present in membrane. Hence, particles of colloidal solution can't pass through membrane.
II. Animal bladder can be used as an membrane.
III. Cellophane is a thin transparent sheet made of cellulose. It used as an membrane.

IV. Ions or small molecules can diffuse through membrane into water.
Hence, correct statements are II and IV.
